articles.title: At Pennsylvania Summit, Trump Touts Defense Tech Amid Depleted Missile Stockpiles
articles.summary: President Trump headlined a defense summit at the Army War College, highlighting battlefield tech investments. But the Iran war has drained Tomahawk and Patriot stocks; replenishment could take three years. A $1.5 trillion budget proposal is stalled in Congress.

articles.title: Starmer Bows Out at Final PMQs with Tributes, Jokes, and a Standing Ovation
articles.summary: In his last Prime Minister’s Questions, Keir Starmer called it the “end of my political journey.” MPs across parties traded barbs for praise, with some allies in tears. He hands over to Andy Burnham on Monday after a Labour conference.

articles.title: Trump's Ex-Lawyer Grilled: Can He Lead Justice Impartially?
articles.summary: Todd Blanche, once Trump's personal defense attorney, faced a contentious Senate hearing on July 15, 2026, as he seeks confirmation as Attorney General. Senators probed his independence after controversial moves like shielding Trump from IRS tax probes. His confirmation hangs in the balance.
